def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args])


def raw(ref, path):
    return git("show", ref + ":" + path)


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def census(ref):
    result = {}
    for entry in git("ls-tree", "-r", "-z", ref, "--", *SCOPES).split(b"\0"):
        if entry:
            metadata, path = entry.split(b"\t", 1)
            mode, kind, blob = metadata.decode().split()
            result[path.decode()] = (mode, kind, blob)
    return result


def summary(entries):
    return {
        "tracked_paths": len(entries),
        "file_modes": dict(collections.Counter(x[0] for x in entries.values())),
        "object_types": dict(collections.Counter(x[1] for x in entries.values())),
        "suffixes": dict(collections.Counter(pathlib.PurePosixPath(p).suffix or "<none>" for p in entries)),
    }


def point(path, qualified_name):
    data = raw(ROOT, path)
    lines = data.decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
    target = qualified_name.split(".")
    node = ast.parse(data)
    for name in target:
        matches = [n for n in node.body if isinstance(n, (ast.ClassDef, ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and n.name == name]
        assert len(matches) == 1, (path, qualified_name)
        node = matches[0]
    start = min([node.lineno] + [d.lineno for d in getattr(node, "decorator_list", [])])
    segment = "".join(lines[start - 1:node.end_lineno]).encode()
    return {"path": path, "qualified_name": qualified_name, "first_line": start, "last_line": node.end_lineno, "file_sha256": digest(data), "segment_sha256": digest(segment), "source_sha": ROOT}
